subject: MATH150
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 high-quality videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics in discrete mathematics. The chosen videos are highly relevant, popular, and directly address the common student difficulties outlined for each topic. Coverage is complete for all topics and languages, with strong candidates found for each.

coverage.note: Most candidates were on standard linear algebra (matrices), not modular arithmetic. Of the relevant ones, only one passed the view count gate.

coverage.topic: Primes and Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
Primes and Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
coverage.note: Many candidates were on related but less specific topics like basic arithmetic or calculus theorems.

videos.title: Extended Euclidean Algorithm Example
videos.filter_reason: Excellent, clear walkthrough of the extended Euclidean algorithm, focusing on the backward substitution to find Bézout's coefficients.

videos.title: Solve a Linear Congruence using Euclid's Algorithm
videos.filter_reason: Perfectly demonstrates how to solve a linear congruence by finding the multiplicative inverse using the Euclidean algorithm, directly addressing the core difficulty.

videos.title: What does a ≡ b (mod n) mean? Basic Modular Arithmetic, Congruence
videos.filter_reason: A concise and extremely clear introduction to the meaning of congruence, offering three different interpretations to build strong intuition.

videos.title: Lec-2: Convert Decimal to Any Other Base(Binary, Octal, Hex etc) | Number System
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains and demonstrates the repeated division algorithm for converting from decimal to other bases, which is the primary source of student errors.

videos.title: Discrete Math - 4.3.1 Prime Numbers and Their Properties
videos.topic_en: Primes and Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
videos.topic_ar: الأعداد الأولية والمبرهنة الأساسية في الحساب
videos.filter_reason: A well-structured university-level video that introduces prime numbers, the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, and related algorithms like trial division.

videos.title: [Arabic] Math / Basics / Extended Euclidean Algorithm (Finding the Multiplicative Inverse)
videos.filter_reason: This is a clear, well-regarded tutorial on using the Extended Euclidean Algorithm, framed through its direct application of finding a multiplicative inverse.

videos.title: شرح modular maltiplecative inverse المعكوس الضربى لباقى القسمة بأسهل طريقة
videos.filter_reason: A focused and clear explanation of the modular multiplicative inverse, which is the key concept needed to solve linear congruences.

videos.title: Number Theory - Modular Arithmetic (Arabic)
videos.filter_reason: An excellent introduction to modular arithmetic using the clock analogy, from a channel well-respected for competitive programming and discrete math topics.

videos.title: شرح الانظمة العددية بالتفصيل - التحويلات بين الانظمة
videos.channel: Dr. Aya Nasser - د. آية ناصر
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive and extremely popular lecture that covers all necessary base conversions in detail, including the difficult repeated division method.
